title: Fix Catalogue Tiles Morph To Labels
description: Bauteilarten (#/0/10) to Bauteilbeschriftungen (#/0/11): many-to-one tile morph. Only one element transitions; embodiment switches before position morph so text morphs instead of tiles. Fix settle/bridge ordering so all column tiles animate into labels.
summary:
Fixed Bauteilarten→Bauteilbeschriftungen morph so all three column figure regions animate instead of label text.

- Call `prepareArrangementBeforeAutoAnimate` on `slidechanged` (before reveal.js measures), not on `autoanimate` (too late).
- Force layout reflow after adding `presentation-arrangement--settled`.
- Custom `presentationAutoAnimateMatcher` matches only `[data-id]` so placeholder/crop alt text does not pair with label headings.
- Removed placeholder `h2` from figure crop morph slots.

Tests: `@framework/presentation/core` and `@framework/presentation/renderer/react` pass.
